status_note: LOADER ONLY. lab.effector dispatches on kind and gives this file a Gripper class, and that is the whole of the integration today. The Gripper class has NO motion methods; lab/deck.py does not reference effectors at all; lab/simulate.py checks plunger POS only for Pipette, so a gripper POS would be emitted unvalidated. Every numeric field below is a placeholder and MUST be measured before this file is used to generate motion. lab.effector refuses to load a placeholder unless allow_placeholder=True.

actuator.note: If the gripper is driven by the same ACTUATOR_MOVE macro, these are POS values on that axis. If it gets its own macro, add a macro_name field here and the loader will use it instead.

carries_labware_note: NOT IMPLEMENTED. Unlike a pipette the gripper would change the deck LAYOUT at runtime: picking a plate empties a slot and fills the effector. Nothing tracks that yet - Gripper.held is written by nothing, and the simulator has no notion of a moved placement. Building the gripper means adding that tracking, plus grip/release/move_labware primitives on Machine.
